name: Trivia
description: Quiz rounds with scores: play AeroTrivia on its page, or ask the bot to quiz you in chat.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.stats: Trivia scores so far: games played, the average score, the best score and the last game.
tools.list_categories: List the trivia question categories and how many questions each has.
tools.ask_question: Get one multiple-choice trivia question to quiz people with. Read the question and the options A to D; the answer comes last, to say after they guess.
tools.record_result: Save the score of a trivia round played in chat: how many answers were right out of how many.

ask_question: ask me a science trivia question
record_result: save our trivia round: we got 7 out of 10 right in history

consent: Trivia keeps your scores in its own data folder on this computer. Its questions come with it. It does not use the internet.
